download_caltech_101: download the Caltech101 dataset archive and extract it to the specified root directory
create_caltech_101_disk_folder: create train and test splits of Caltech101 with 30 samples per category following the VTAB protocol
get_argument_parser: get an argument parser that accepts input, output, and download flags for the Caltech101 dataset script
cleanup_unused_files: cleanup unused Caltech101 folders and archive files after creating the VISSL compatible dataset format
run_caltech101_script: run the Caltech101 dataset creation script with input, output paths and optional download flag
